# entomo

> entomo is the agentic intelligence platform for performance and skills, powering 30M+ users across
> enterprises and governments. entomo.ai is the platform; axon is the intelligence behind it; Enzo is the
> AI co-worker inside it; TMRW is entomo's national talent transformation platform.

Canonical site: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/
Every figure on this site is drawn from entomo's published record for that client.

## platform
- [entomo | the agentic intelligence platform for work](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/): agentic intelligence that coaches every employee and advises every leader across performance, skills and growth. powering 30M+ users worldwide.
- [entomo axon | the intelligence behind entomo.ai](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/platform/axon/): axon is the intelligence behind entomo.ai. it connects what every role requires with what every person brings, into one model of how work gets done.
- [Enzo | the AI co-worker inside entomo.ai](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/platform/enzo/): Enzo is the AI co-worker inside entomo.ai: 28 capabilities across six pillars of the employee journey, every one grounded in axon.
- [the entomo.ai platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/platform/): entomo.ai is the agentic intelligence platform for work: axon is the intelligence behind it, Enzo the co-worker you talk to, DIA the assistant for workforce data, TMRW the national talent platform.
- [TMRW: from skills to employability](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/platform/tmrw/): TMRW by entomo turns a national skills framework into employment outcomes: skills, learning, credentials, jobs and mobility in one ecosystem.
- [DIA, the data intelligence assistant](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/dia/): DIA is entomo's data intelligence assistant: ask any workforce question in plain language and get a board-ready recommendation, not a chart.

## solutions
- [solutions](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/): seven products and eleven use cases on one agentic intelligence platform: performance, skills, engagement, planning and the decisions between them.
- [competency framework creation](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/competency-framework-creation/): build a living competency framework on axon: AI market intelligence, 4,000+ pre-built roles, proficiency levels and expert sign-off.
- [employee engagement platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-intelligence/): continuous employee engagement and culture: agentic intelligence that listens to your workforce, celebrates contributions and surfaces signals for leaders.
- [employee engagement and retention](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/engagement-retention/): keep your best people: continuous listening, sentiment and burnout signals in real time, and the recognition, mentorship and growth paths that retain them.
- [enterprise performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/epmo/): an enterprise performance management office as advisory plus platform: every KPI aligned from strategy map to individual scorecard, kept continuous by AI.
- [hire to retire platform](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/hire-to-retire/): one employee journey: agentic intelligence that unifies recruitment, onboarding, payroll, attendance and exit into one experience for HR and employees.
- [internal mobility](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/internal-mobility/): internal mobility on entomo: career paths computed from skill adjacency, opportunities matched to skills and aspirations, and succession driven by skills.
- [learning ROI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/learning-roi/): learning curated to the gap, not the catalogue: entomo targets learning at assessment-verified skill gaps and verifies the proficiency change afterwards.
- [AI performance management](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/performance-intelligence/): close the gap between goals and execution: agentic intelligence that coaches every employee, equips every manager and surfaces performance signals live.
- [skills intelligence for careers and learning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/skill-intelligence/): skills intelligence that maps what your workforce has, validates it against what roles require, and grows the capability the gap reveals. built on axon.
- [strategic performance management office](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/spmo/): build and run a strategic performance management office: balanced scorecards, strategy maps and a KPI cascade from corporate strategy to every scorecard.
- [strategic workforce planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/strategic-planning/): project workforce demand and talent supply, surface the gap by role, model the scenarios, and get a build, buy, borrow or bot recommendation for every gap.
- [succession planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/succession-planning/): succession planning with agentic AI: critical roles risk-scored, successor readiness scored on evidence, nine-box calibration and ready-now talent pools.
- [employee wellbeing intelligence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/wellness-intelligence/): protect your people's wellbeing: agentic intelligence that senses wellness signals early, nudges proactively, and acts before stress becomes attrition.
- [workforce analytics and reporting](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-analytics/): workforce analytics you can ask in plain language: decision-ready answers, ISO 30414-aligned human capital reporting and market benchmarks.
- [workforce assessments at scale](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-assessments/): skill assessments built from the role's axon blueprint, generated with AI, approved by your experts and scored to proficiency. live in weeks, not quarters.
- [workforce insights for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-insights/): every workforce question deserves a real answer, not a dashboard: agentic AI that interprets your people data and recommends what to do next.
- [workforce planning](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/solutions/workforce-planning/): workforce planning with agentic AI: model demand against strategy, rank skill gaps, compare build, buy, borrow or bot for every need, and score succession.

## research and downloads
- [30 revolutionary ideas for our remote age](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/30-ideas-remote-age/): thirty ideas from thirty HR and education influencers on what remote work changes permanently.
- [the agentic HR operating model](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/agentic-hr-operating-model/): what changes when intelligence acts inside the process rather than reporting on it, with a maturity model PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/agentic-hr-operating-model.pdf
- [augmenting human capital management with AI](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/augmenting-hcm-with-ai/): where talent analytics matures, from reporting to recommendation: a report on augmenting human capital management with AI, written with ETHRWorld.
- [evolution of career readiness: singapore](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/career-readiness-singapore/): a study of which roles and skills stayed resilient as the singapore career landscape shifted.
- [governing AI in HR: a readiness guide](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/governing-ai-in-hr/): a readiness guide to the EU AI Act, NYC Local Law 144 and the documentation your HR systems must hold to pass an audit. PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/governing-ai-in-hr.pdf
- [HRTech for best-in-class talent engagement](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/hrtech-talent-engagement/): a four-part webinar series on the platforms reshaping digital HR, recorded with IHRP Singapore.
- [human capital disclosure: ISO 30414 and CSRD](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd/): a metric-by-metric readiness guide to ISO 30414:2025 and the workforce disclosures inside the revised EU standards PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/human-capital-disclosure-iso-30414-csrd.pdf
- [an internal talent marketplace people use](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/internal-talent-marketplace-people-use/): the operating model, manager incentives and metrics that separate a working marketplace from an empty job board PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/internal-talent-marketplace-people-use.pdf
- [mastering risk and performance in the next normal](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/mastering-risk-and-performance/): essential practices for enterprises and employees operating across owned, shared and remote workplaces.
- [reform and reimagine workplace practices](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/reform-reimagine-roadmap/): part two of the returning-to-work roadmap, a self-check across the react, respond, reform and reimagine stages.
- [return to work: a self-assessment for leaders](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/return-to-work-self-assessment/): part one of the returning-to-work roadmap, built around a yes or no self-check for leadership teams.
- [the skills-based organisation, practically](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/skills-based-organisation-practically/): a staged first-year guide from role architecture to skills-based staffing, with what to do in each quarter PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/skills-based-organisation-practically.pdf
- [workforce planning when AI changes the work](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/resources/workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work/): how to model demand and supply when task composition shifts, with a build, buy, borrow, bot matrix PDF: https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/downloads/workforce-planning-when-ai-changes-the-work.pdf

## writing
- [assessing skills at scale without fooling yourself](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/assessing-skills-at-scale-without-fooling-yourself/): validity is an argument you build, reliability is the ceiling you cannot exceed, and most internal assessments fail on both.
- [autonomy should be a dial, not a switch](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/autonomy-is-a-dial-not-a-switch/): a four-level model for governing AI in HR, with what to log at each level and the evidence required to move a use case up.
- [burnout is a job design problem, not a resilience problem](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/burnout-is-a-job-design-problem/): the evidence points at demands, resources and control, yet most organisations respond by measuring how well people cope with them.
- [career paths people can walk](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/career-paths-people-can-walk/): career frameworks name destinations and skip the route; paths built from skill distance tell people where they can go next.
- [your engagement survey measures the wrong latency](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/engagement-surveys-measure-the-wrong-latency/): engagement moves day to day, the annual survey reports once a year, and the gap between those two clocks is where most listening programmes fail.
- [goal quality is measurable, and most goals fail the test](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/goal-quality-is-a-measurable-property/): a goal nobody can review produces no feedback, and that failure can be scored, sampled and tracked across an entire organisation.
- [internal mobility runs on two clocks](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/internal-mobility-two-clocks/): one clock fills the role open this month, the other builds the career that takes three years, and most organisations wind only one of them.
- [the job description is the wrong unit of analysis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/job-description-wrong-unit-of-analysis/): job titles average away the variation that matters, and the decisions enterprises now face need a smaller unit than the job.
- [learning spend needs a chain of evidence](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/learning-roi-chain-of-evidence/): training evaluation stops at satisfaction scores because the next four links are unowned, not because they are impossible.
- [your skills taxonomy is a dictionary, not a diagnosis](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/skills-taxonomy-dictionary-not-diagnosis/): a taxonomy resolves what to call things, and cannot tell you proficiency, context or currency, which is where every workforce decision lives.
- [succession slates need evidence, not ratings](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/succession-readiness-is-evidence/): nine-box grids produce agreement quickly and accuracy rarely, and a board question will find the difference every time.
- [the workforce report your board and your auditor both accept](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/the-board-ready-workforce-report/): ISO 30414 became a requirements standard in 2025 and the EU narrowed CSRD in 2026, which changes what a credible disclosure set looks like.
- [the queue between a question and its answer](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/the-queue-between-question-and-answer/): self-service analytics never removed the wait for workforce answers, because the slow part was never retrieval.
- [why competency frameworks die in month seven](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/why-competency-frameworks-die-in-month-seven/): role requirements drift faster than any rewrite cycle; a framework survives only if it is maintained monthly like an operating system.
- [workforce planning is a decision, not a spreadsheet](https://entomomarketing.github.io/PX/V3/blog/workforce-planning-is-a-decision-not-a-spreadsheet/): build, buy, borrow or bot: every capability needs a supply decision on the record, with the evidence that would reverse it.
